Query Builder

An advanced query builder with extended operators, nested AND/OR groups, live query preview, and save/load query templates.

Query Builder

Features

  • Extended Operators — =, !=, >, <, >=, <=, contains, starts with, ends with, in, between, is null, is not null.
  • Nested Groups — Add filter groups inside other groups.
  • AND/OR Logic — Each group supports AND or OR conjunction.
  • Live Preview — Real-time text representation of the query.
  • Templates — Save and load query templates from a dropdown.
  • Field Types — Name, Email, Department, Status, Salary, Join Date.
